LEARNING PATH · CLASS 46 · EARLY ADDITION & SUBTRACTION · AGES 4–5

Early addition & subtraction for kids — thirty printable math cards that never spoil the answer.

Thirty printable addition and subtraction flashcards for ages four to five, all on this one page, in two shelves. Sixteen sums that build up, fourteen that take away, from tiny 1 + 2 to the whole take-from-ten family. Every card shows smiling cartoon numbers acting the sum out and prints the equation with the answer LEFT BLANK — working it out is the game, and every card downloads and prints straight from this page with a real thing to count, hold or munch to find it. Pick a card, print it, and the kitchen table becomes a math lab.

Back to the Learning Path ↗
HOW THIS CLASS WORKS

The answer is never on the card. That is the trick.

Every card in this class prints a smiling number story — a 1 running away from a 10, two 3s bumping heads — and the equation underneath ends in a blank: 3 + 4 = ___. Nothing to look up, nothing filled in. Your child counts it out, and the moment they land on the number themselves is the moment it sticks. You do not need a desk for this class. You need fingers, snacks, toy cars and one honest staircase to jump down.

The two shelves follow how sums grow. The Addition shelf starts inside 5 — one more, two more, the first double — and climbs to the famous ten pair 6 + 4. The Subtraction shelf starts with one hopping off, meets the sneaking middles, and finishes with the take-from-ten family, where 10 itself waves its friends goodbye. The 10 − 3 sum even ships as two different drawings, and both print right here on the class page.

THE ADDITION SHELF · 16 CARDS

Sums that build up.

Printable addition flashcards for kindergarten and preschool: every sum inside 10, from tiny 1-plus friends to the famous make-ten pair 6 + 4. The answer is never printed — working it out is the whole game, one card at a time. Every card carries its four pills — age, subject, grade level, skill — and its Download + Print buttons right under the picture, straight from this page.

THE SUBTRACTION SHELF · 14 CARDS

Sums that take away.

Printable subtraction flashcards for ages 4–5: one-away sums to warm up, sneaking middles, and the whole take-from-ten family — the 10 − 3 card even ships as two drawings. Somebody is always sneaking out the door, and counting who stays is the game. Every card carries its four pills — age, subject, grade level, skill — and its Download + Print buttons right under the picture, straight from this page.

AROUND THE SCHOOL

Where these sums grow up.

Counting lessons in Class 35 · Ages 4–5 ↗Measuring & Money in Class 42 · Ages 4–5 ↗Thinking games in Class 30 · Ages 4–5 ↗The Learning Path ↗

Class 35 counts from one apple to twenty figs — the numbers this class finally adds and takes away. Class 42 spends sums as money and measures with them, and Class 30 turns thinking itself into games. Learn a sum here, meet it again everywhere. And when you want the next class, the Learning Path holds all forty-nine in order — and the whole deck prints again from the Early Addition & Subtraction parents’ shelf.

Math is caught at the kitchen table, not taught at a desk. Every card here hands you a sum to act out with real things — and your grown-up’s whole job is to count out loud with you until the answer shows up on its own.
